name: Trap Ball Adventure
detailed_description:
Join Princess Eight as she flees her fate through labyrinthine sewers and treacherous lands filled with traps.
Will she be able to gather the courage needed to face the truth that has always been right in front of her? Because freedom, after all, always comes at a price.

Eight begins her journey when betrayal locks her away and the kingdom collapses. King Pool, once full of vigor, has lost the fire of his youth, and the royal advisor Ovaline has seized the opportunity to carry out his coup, stealing the glory, power, and the Crown of Niké.

Will the princess be able to pay the price of her liberation, or will she find within herself the strength to carry the weight of her legacy?

«Trap Ball Adventure» is a 2.5D platforming adventure where you'll need to master your timing, reflexes, and momentum.
Perfect your jumping, hitting, and movement skills to overcome deadly obstacles and defeat enemies lurking in the depths of this fantastic world.
Launch yourself from great heights with the devastating Carom Impact and smash through your foes.

Traverse sewer mazes and treacherous lands full of traps. Solve puzzles to progress and uncover secrets on your path to freedom.
The truth will be revealed—if you're brave enough to face it.

The Kingdom of Sphereland is torn in a struggle for power, glory, and the Crown of Niké.
On one side is the aging but noble King Pool, whose spark has faded with time. Wishing to pass the crown to Princess Eight, he finds her unwilling to accept the burdens of royalty.

On the other side, the ambitious Visir Ovaline plots a coup to take control of the throne.

Inspired by the hero’s journey, this tale follows Princess Eight as she abandons her life of luxury to confront an unexpected destiny.
With the coronation near and the coup about to unfold, she begins a desperate escape through the castle’s dark, foul-smelling sewers.

Can a pampered princess rise to become the hero her kingdom needs?

As she journeys forward, Eight must not only flee but also grow—finding courage and shaping her character. She'll evolve from carefree to commanding, discovering that every obstacle is a chance to prove she’s worthy of leadership.

But danger lurks at every corner—enemies must be observed, analyzed… or even turned into allies.

With a vibrant visual style and unique spherical characters, this medieval world blended with fantastical tech will grab you from the very first moment.

Sharpen your reflexes!
Take on a challenge that's accessible for all ages but demands precision and timing.

Do you have what it takes to help Eight escape the Visir Ovaline and restore peace to Sphereland?

  • 2.5D platforming and adventure.

  • A classic experience with a modern twist to test your skills.

  • Custom jump mechanics. Adjust the strength of your jumps and master the Carom Impact to clear your path.

Single-player mode | Ages 9+ | Action, platforming, and adventure with humor and strategy.
